records.key: Drag a line on either image to measure its length in image pixels. Right-click with Ruler selected to clear it. Turn Ruler off to pan.
records.source: Drag a line on either image to measure its length in image pixels. Right-click with Ruler selected to clear it. Turn Ruler off to pan.
records.translation: 在任一图像上拖出线段，以图像像素测量其长度。选中标尺时单击右键可清除线段。关闭标尺后可平移。

records.key: Drag a line to measure its length in image pixels. Right-click with Ruler selected to clear it. Zoom and pan preserve the measurement.
records.source: Drag a line to measure its length in image pixels. Right-click with Ruler selected to clear it. Zoom and pan preserve the measurement.
records.translation: 拖出线段，以图像像素测量其长度。选中标尺时单击右键可清除线段。缩放和平移会保留测量。

records.key: Pixel spacing must be finite and positive.
records.source: Pixel spacing must be finite and positive.
records.translation: 像素间距必须为有限正数。
